shots.actions: the queue runs from the factory gate all the way to the crossing and the wheel ruts are pressed into the grey fog with one set of prints laid over another; the queued people are silhouettes and the line turns deeper into the fog; a queue lane is kept on each side of the gate and the caller never enters the frame
